project: SISO - Validação de OC na Separação
description: Introduz fase de validação física de OC na separação. Após aprovação, o worker marca itens faltantes como oc_pendente e o pedido entra em validacao_oc. O operador confere fisicamente no checklist: clique = encontrou+bipado, esgotado = vai pra compras. Comprador só vê itens confirmados esgotados. PRD completo em tasks/prd-validacao-oc-separacao.md

userStories.title: concluir/route.ts OC guard and aguardando_compra branch
userStories.description: As a system, I want concluir to block if oc_pendente items remain, exclude confirmed OC items from completude check, and transition to aguardando_compra when OC items exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Expand the items select to include compra_status — change .select('id, pedido_id, separacao_marcado') to .select('id, pedido_id, separacao_marcado, compra_status')
Add guard: before the completude check, if any item has compra_status = 'oc_pendente', return 400 with error 'Há itens OC não validados — resolva todos os itens na conferência OC antes de concluir'

Modify the completude check: exclude items where compra_status is in ['aguardando_compra', 'comprado'] from the separacao_marcado verification. Only check separacao_marcado on items where compra_status is null.

Add new transition branch: when all remaining (non-compra) items are marcado AND there are items with compra_status in ['aguardando_compra', 'comprado'], transition to status_separacao = 'aguardando_compra' instead of 'separado'. Do NOT set separacao_concluida_em in this branch (it is not a completed separation, it is a partial pause for purchases).
In the aguardando_compra branch, do NOT reset separacao_marcado, bipado_completo, or quantidade_bipada on any items — preserve the pick state of normal items.
The existing 'separado' transition path remains unchanged for pedidos without compra items.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Read src/app/api/separacao/concluir/route.ts fully first. The current flow: fetch items -> group by pedido -> check marks.every(Boolean) -> update to separado. The changes add: (1) compra_status to select, (2) early return on oc_pendente, (3) filter out compra items before completude check, (4) branch to aguardando_compra when compra items exist. The key insight: items with aguardando_compra/comprado are 'not my problem right now' — they are handled by the compras module.

userStories.title: cancelar + voltar-etapa support validacao_oc
userStories.description: As a system, I want cancelar to return pedidos to the correct status (validacao_oc vs aguardando_compra) and voltar-etapa to support the new status.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/app/api/separacao/cancelar/route.ts: modify the return-status logic (around lines 52-58 where it checks compra_status != null). Current logic: if compra items exist -> aguardando_compra, else -> aguardando_separacao. New logic: if any item has compra_status = 'oc_pendente' -> return to 'validacao_oc'; else if items have compra_status = 'aguardando_compra' (without any oc_pendente) -> return to 'aguardando_compra'; else -> return to 'aguardando_separacao'.
In src/app/api/separacao/voltar-etapa/route.ts: add 'validacao_oc' to the STATUS_ORDER array, positioned between 'aguardando_nf' and 'aguardando_separacao'.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Read both files first. The cancelar logic queries items with compra_status != null to decide the return status. The key change is adding a priority check: oc_pendente takes precedence (means the pedido hasn't finished validation). For voltar-etapa, STATUS_ORDER is a simple array — insert validacao_oc at the right position.

userStories.title: New endpoint POST /api/separacao/validar-oc-item
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a new API endpoint that handles both 'encontrei' and 'esgotado' actions for OC items, including auto-transitions when all OC items are resolved.
acceptanceCriteria: Create route.ts at src/app/api/separacao/validar-oc-item/route.ts
POST accepts { item_ids: string[], acao: 'encontrei' | 'esgotado' }
Requires valid session via getSessionUser (X-Session-Id header). Return 401 if no session.
Validate: item_ids must be non-empty string array, acao must be 'encontrei' or 'esgotado'. Return 400 on invalid input.

For acao 'encontrei': update each item in item_ids with compra_status = null, fornecedor_oc = null, compra_quantidade_solicitada = null, compra_solicitada_em = null, ordem_compra_id = null, AND separacao_marcado = true, bipado_completo = true, quantidade_bipada = quantidade_pedida (fetch quantidade_pedida first). This marks the item as found AND picked in one step.

For acao 'esgotado': update each item with compra_status = 'aguardando_compra', compra_quantidade_solicitada = quantidade_pedida, compra_solicitada_em = now(). Use getFornecedorBySku(sku) to fill fornecedor_oc if not already set. Auto-create or find an existing OC (siso_ordens_compra) by fornecedor + galpao — reuse the same pattern as produto-esgotado/route.ts OC creation logic. Link items to the OC via ordem_compra_id.
After processing items, for each affected pedido: query all items of that pedido and check if any still have compra_status = 'oc_pendente'. If none remain (all resolved):

- Auto-transition FR-9: if NO items have compra_status in ['aguardando_compra', 'comprado'] (all found), update pedido decisao_final from 'oc' to 'propria'. If pedido is in 'validacao_oc', transition to 'aguardando_separacao'. If in 'em_separacao', keep as is.

- Auto-transition FR-8: if ALL OC items are now 'aguardando_compra' AND pedido has NO items with compra_status = null (100% OC pedido), transition to 'aguardando_compra', clear separacao_operador_id and separacao_iniciada_em, do NOT set separacao_concluida_em.
Register history events via registrarEvento: 'oc_item_encontrado' for encontrei, 'oc_item_confirmado' for esgotado, with SKU and operador in detalhes.
Return { itens_atualizados: number, transicoes: [{ pedido_id, novo_status }] }
Log errors via logger.logError with source 'validar-oc-item' and category 'business_logic'
Update docs/api-reference-complete.md with full endpoint documentation
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the core new endpoint. Model the OC creation logic after src/app/api/separacao/produto-esgotado/route.ts lines 245-400 (the 'oc' acao block): getFornecedorBySku for supplier, find-or-create siso_ordens_compra by fornecedor + galpao, link items via ordem_compra_id. For the 'encontrei' action, the key insight is that clicking = found + bipado in one step, so set both compra fields to null AND separacao fields to true. Import getFornecedorBySku from '@/lib/sku-fornecedor', registrarEvento from '@/lib/historico-service', getSessionUser from '@/lib/session'.

userStories.title: separacao/page.tsx tab architecture for validacao_oc

acceptanceCriteria: In src/app/separacao/page.tsx: decouple VisibleSeparacaoTab from StatusSeparacao — change it to a string literal union that excludes 'validacao_oc' (since validacao_oc shares the aguardando_compra tab, not its own tab)

In EMPTY_COUNTS: add validacao_oc: 0
In MOVE_TARGETS: add a validacao_oc entry so admin can move pedidos to this status
Where the tab badge count is computed for the aguardando_compra tab: sum counts.aguardando_compra + counts.validacao_oc for the displayed badge number

When the Aguardando OC tab is active and fetches pedidos: the list should show BOTH status values. Either make two sequential fetches (?status_separacao=validacao_oc then ?status_separacao=aguardando_compra) and merge results, or add support for a comma-separated status param. The simpler approach: fetch with .in('status_separacao', ['aguardando_compra', 'validacao_oc']) — check how the existing fetch works and extend it.
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Read src/app/separacao/page.tsx first 150 lines to understand TAB_CONFIG, VisibleSeparacaoTab type, EMPTY_COUNTS, and how tabs trigger data fetches. The key challenge: the current architecture is 1:1 between tab ID and status_separacao value. The OC tab breaks this by mapping to TWO statuses. The cleanest approach is to handle this in the fetch logic: when activeTab === 'aguardando_compra', fetch both statuses.

userStories.title: Checklist page OC conference section
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the checklist page to show a delimited 'Conferência OC' section at the top with OC items using the same item component, where clicking marks as found+bipado and the esgotado button sends to compras.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/app/separacao/checklist/page.tsx: split the item consolidation into two groups — items with compra_status = 'oc_pendente' go to ocItems, all others go to normalItems. Use produto_id + is_oc as consolidation key to prevent merging OC and normal items of the same SKU.
Both groups are sorted independently by location (naturalLocCompare)

When ocItems is non-empty: render a visually delimited section at the top with amber border/background and title 'Conferência OC' (with ShoppingCart or similar icon). Render OC items using the same item row component as normal items.
Normal items render below in the existing section (no visual change to existing behavior)

When operator clicks an OC item (same click interaction as normal items): call POST /api/separacao/validar-oc-item with { item_ids: [item.id], acao: 'encontrei' }. On success, optimistically update the item to show green/marked state (compra_status = null, separacao_marcado = true).

When operator clicks the esgotado button on an OC item (same esgotado button as normal checklist): call POST /api/separacao/validar-oc-item with { item_ids: [item.id], acao: 'esgotado' }. On success, optimistically update the item to show esgotado state (compra_status = 'aguardando_compra', greyed out).
If the API response includes transicoes (auto-transitions), handle them: if pedido transitions to aguardando_separacao or aguardando_compra, show a toast and invalidate queries.
OC items marked as found (green) stay in the OC section — they do not move to the normal section
OC items marked as esgotado (grey) stay in the OC section with esgotado visual
If ocItems becomes empty after all resolved, the OC section disappears
The barcode scanner input continues to work only for the normal section items
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Read src/app/separacao/checklist/page.tsx (large file, ~1000+ lines). The current consolidation is in a useMemo that groups by produto_id. Split this into two useMemos (or one that returns { ocItems, normalItems }). The OC section uses the SAME item row component but wraps it in an amber-bordered container. For the click handler, the existing marcar-item flow won't work for OC items — use the new validar-oc-item endpoint instead. For esgotado, check how the existing esgotado button works (it may call produto-esgotado) and redirect OC items to validar-oc-item instead.

userStories.title: Worker activation - executarMarcadoresOnly emits oc_pendente + validacao_oc
userStories.description: As a system, I want the execution worker to mark missing items as oc_pendente (not aguardando_compra) and set pedido status to validacao_oc, activating the new OC validation flow.
acceptanceCriteria: In src/lib/execution-worker.ts function resolveCompraItemIds: expand the .select() from 'id, produto_id, quantidade_pedida' to 'id, produto_id, quantidade_pedida, sku'. Update the return type to include sku: string. In the demandas push (around line 548), include sku: String(item.sku ?? '').
In src/lib/execution-worker.ts function executarMarcadoresOnly around line 673: change .update({ status_separacao: 'aguardando_compra' }) to .update({ status_separacao: 'validacao_oc' })

In the item update loop around line 680: change compra_status: 'aguardando_compra' to compra_status: 'oc_pendente'. Add fornecedor_oc: getFornecedorBySku(demanda.sku).fornecedor to the update object. Import getFornecedorBySku from '@/lib/sku-fornecedor' at the top of the file.
The compraDemandas.length === 0 path (lines 609-666) remains completely unchanged — when no items are missing, the pedido still converts to propria.
Verify: existing OC pedidos already in aguardando_compra are not affected (they were processed by the old code path).
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: CRITICAL: This is the activation story. All previous stories (US-001 through US-009) MUST be completed and deployed before this one. Without the UI and backend support, pedidos with validacao_oc status would be stuck with no way to resolve them. The changes are small (3 targeted modifications + 1 function signature expansion) but they activate the entire feature. Read src/lib/execution-worker.ts lines 467-695 to understand the full context. The getFornecedorBySku function is already used in producto-esgotado/route.ts — check that import for reference.
